Booking terms

Terms and conditions

Last updated: 15 November 2026

These terms apply when you book a place on a Beyond the Shift training camp, by the booking form or online. “We” means Beyond the Shift (James Foster and Kai Wolgram). “You” means the person making the booking, usually a parent or guardian of the sailor.

1. Booking and confirmation

  • A booking is a request for a place. Your place is confirmed when we contact you personally after your payment has arrived.
  • Places are limited and allocated in the order payments arrive. If a camp is full, you can join the waiting list; please don’t pay until we offer you a place.
  • Camps are for ILCA 4 and 6 sailors, primarily those racing nationally with international aspirations. We may suggest a different camp if one is a better fit.

2. Prices and payment

  • Prices are shown on the camp listing and in your booking email. Payment is by bank transfer using the reference we give you.
  • Payment is due 7 days after booking, or 7 days before the camp starts if that is sooner.
  • Bookings made in the final 7 days before a camp include a £20 late booking fee, and payment is due straight away.
  • If payment hasn’t arrived by the due date, we may offer the place to someone else after letting you know.

3. Before the camp

  • A parent or guardian (or the sailor, if 18 or over) must complete our medical and image release form before the sailor goes afloat.
  • Sailors bring their own ILCA in good, race-ready condition, plus suitable clothing, a buoyancy aid that fits and is worn at all times on the water, and food and water for the day.
  • Sailors must be able to sail their boat independently and right it after a capsize.

4. On the water and safety

  • Coaching runs from coach boats with safety cover. The coaches decide whether it is safe to sail, and may change, shorten or move sessions for weather or safety. Their decision is final.
  • Sailors must follow coach instructions and the rules of the host venue. We may send a sailor ashore if their behaviour puts themselves or others at risk.
  • Sailing has risks. Sailors take part at their own risk, apart from anything caused by our negligence. We are not responsible for loss of or damage to boats or personal kit, so please make sure your boat is insured.

5. Changes and cancellations

See our cancellation policy for what happens if you or we need to cancel.

6. Photos, video and data

We film sessions for coaching. How we use photos and video is set out in our photography and video consent page, and how we handle personal information in our privacy notice.

7. Questions

Reply to any booking email or message us on the WhatsApp information group.
